reuse.why: Changes only the existing shared getScheduledAmount and keeps using getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance.

duplication.why: The rule exists once and the change shrinks it; nothing is duplicated.

placement.why: The edit stays in shared/schedules.ts, where every planning consumer already gets the rule.

scope.why: Only the rule, its tests and the release note change.

maintainability.why: A minimal, readable change to a single definition, with an updated comment.
